sections: frozen discovery subject and review contract

repo_truth: Discovery review /root/hcm24_planning_discovery_review replayed fingerprint sha256:a49bb62cf5826d819fe94cdf29003e4dac0ca07c88a2d8a7f60b7e3957bbd57f and returned exactly two P2 findings: a cyclic implementation-entry/P0 gate and missing exact descriptor selection for Project Context, Environment Context, and the Work Specification real-path proof. The parent consolidated both in one planning-only remediation. The new five-file subject explicitly makes post-selection P0 read-only before edits, freezes shipped-root intake/renderer rows, freezes an admitted Work Specification repository-profile descriptor and fixture, and adds RED/GREEN/selector proof. No implementation or unrelated scope was added.
allowed_scope: Replay the five-entry manifest and aggregate fingerprint before reviewing.
Review the delta from discovery fingerprint sha256:a49bb62cf5826d819fe94cdf29003e4dac0ca07c88a2d8a7f60b7e3957bbd57f to this subject.
Verify HCM-2.4-DISC-001 is closed without weakening the implementation gate: selection authorizes only read-only P0, and edits remain blocked until P0 passes.

Verify HCM-2.4-DISC-002 is closed: Project Context and Environment Context have exact selected intake/renderer refs, and Work Specification has an exact admitted repository-profile descriptor, source, path, intake, renderer, and selection proof.
Check the complete resulting subject only for contradictions or valid P1/P2 directly caused or unmasked by this remediation.
Apply the integrated-outcome rubric; list P3/P4 separately without opening another general discovery pass.
non_goals: No new general discovery, architecture redesign, speculative robustness campaign, or review of untouched planning choices.
No edits, implementation, test/definition/schema/template changes, staging, commits, pushes, handoffs, ledger writes, dispatch creation, or delegation.
No HCM-3.x, Projection, SDK/transport, remote schema, generated command, dynamic path, migration/dual-read, dependency, Cargo, unsafe-policy, package-boundary, or public API work.
tasks: Verify exact subject identity and planning-only boundary.
Compare the original and remediated subject using the two finding statements as the delta lenses.
Return CLEAN if both P2 findings are closed and no remediation-caused/unmasked P1/P2 exists.
If a P1/P2 exists, demonstrate direct causal or unmasking lineage to the remediation, exact selected-outcome failure, and bounded same-scope fix.
Return P3/P4 only with a canonical-inventory disposition.
stop_conditions: Return blocked if either subject fingerprint cannot be established or cited remediation evidence is unavailable.
Do not reopen general discovery; report only unresolved original findings or directly caused/unmasked P1/P2.
Do not delegate, edit, implement, create another dispatch, write a handoff, or modify the ledger.
